_note: Fictional mails for testing the 'Use my Gmail' feature. 'to' is filled from ADMIN_EMAIL at load time. expected_booking is ground truth for evaluation and is not inserted into Gmail.

messages.subject: Confirmation: Guest lecture on Generative AI for III year CSE
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Walter,

Thank you for the invitation. I am happy to confirm the guest lecture on "Generative AI: From Models to Products" on Monday, 23 November 2026, from 10.00 AM to 12.30 PM.

I understand the audience will be III year CSE students (all four sections, roughly 90 who have opted in). I will need a projector, a lapel mic and an HDMI connection for my laptop.

Regards,
Dr. R. Sundaravel
Professor, Department of Computer Science
Anna University, Chennai

messages.subject: Re: Confirmation: Guest lecture on Generative AI for III year CSE
messages.body:
Dear Sir,

Thank you for confirming. We will arrange the hall and AV and share the venue details shortly.

Regards,
Walter

expected_booking.soft_conflict: CC1-CC6 model practical exams in November (only if CC4 is chosen)

messages.subject: Hands-on Docker & Kubernetes workshop - please arrange
messages.body:
Walter,

Stackbridge Technologies has agreed to run a one-day hands-on workshop on Docker and Kubernetes for our II & III year students on Saturday 28 November, 9.30 AM to 4 PM. We have 55 registrations. Every student needs a system with Docker Desktop installed, so please book suitable labs (two labs is fine) and inform the trainers.

HoD/CSE

messages.subject: Mock interview day for final years - 5 Dec
messages.body:
Dear Coordinator,

We are planning a mock technical interview day for about 60 final year CSE+ students on Saturday, 05.12.2026 from 9 AM to 4 PM with panels from Quantix Systems. Students will bring their own laptops for the coding round. Please block the CoE labs for the day.

Thanks,
Placement & Training Cell

expected_booking.soft_conflict: D Block SH is used for the AICTE FDP in the second week of December every year

messages.subject: AICTE ATAL FDP sanctioned - 14 to 18 Dec 2026
messages.body:
Dear All,

Glad to share that our proposal for a five-day FDP on "Cloud-Native Application Development" has been sanctioned. Dates: 14.12.2026 to 18.12.2026, 9.30 AM to 4.30 PM daily. Expected participants: about 150 faculty from various colleges. Sessions are a mix of talks and demos, so a large hall with projector and PA is required.

Walter, as the coordinator please take care of the venue booking.

R&D Cell

messages.subject: Visit of a senior space scientist - 21 January 2027
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Walter,

A senior scientist from a national space research centre will visit the campus on 21 January 2027. The Principal would like a 90-minute interaction (11.00 AM to 12.30 PM) with about 45 selected students and faculty. Since the Executive Chairman will preside, please arrange one of the main seminar halls with stage and PA.

Principal's Office

expected_booking.soft_conflict: A Block SH is used for admission counselling in March every year

messages.subject: Inauguration of the Cloud Club chapter - March 2027
messages.body:
Hi Sir,

For the Cloud Club inauguration we have pencilled in Wednesday 10 March 2027, 10 AM to 12 noon. About 80 students plus a chief guest from Nimbus Cloudworks. We were thinking of A Block Seminar Hall since it fits 100. Could you please check and book?

Thanks,
Club Secretary

expected_booking.soft_conflict: COE labs host placement training on Saturdays from January to March (13 Feb is a Saturday)

messages.subject: Request for venue - 2-day hackathon (12-13 Feb 2027)
messages.body:
Respected Sir,

We would like to conduct HackKIOT 2.0, a two-day hackathon on 12 and 13 February 2027 (9 AM to 5 PM both days). 14 teams of 4, so 56 participants, all with their own laptops. We need good Wi-Fi and power points at every seat.

Kindly guide us on the venue.

Regards,
Tech Forum Team

messages.subject: VAC on Advanced SQL - lab needed
messages.body:
Hi Walter,

I am offering a 7-day value-added course on Advanced SQL and Query Optimisation for 30 II year students from 4 January 2027, daily 3.10 PM to 4.40 PM. Students will use MySQL Workbench. Can you find a lab that is free in that slot?

Thanks,
Deepa

messages.subject: Re: VAC on Advanced SQL - lab needed
messages.body:
Sure, I will check the lab timetables and book one. Will confirm.

Walter

messages.subject: Networking workshop on 19th Dec
messages.body:
Walter,

Kovai Robotics' network team will run a half-day workshop on enterprise network design for 28 students on 19th December, 9:30 to 1 PM. Hands-on with Cisco Packet Tracer. Please block a lab that has it.

Babu

All faculty are requested to submit pending travel claims for September before 30 October 2026.

Accounts Office

45 new titles on cloud computing, AI and management have been added. The list is attached on the library portal.
